about: Lawrence (7 Nov, 18:06): each tile progresses one thing. CAR (it learns), PLAYER (a part earned) and LEVEL (what the tile offers) interplay; every upgrade is used on the next tile. The engine reads parts and levels; the pipeline's validator reads all of it.

battery1.name: Battery 1
battery1.text: Dash: Space. Reach a car's path from cover set back from the road.

legs1.name: Legs 1
legs1.text: Jump: L. A running jump clears a K-rail.

knees1.name: Super Knees
knees1.text: Duck: hold C. Low cover hides you from its sensors.

hands1.name: Hands 1
hands1.text: Cones: J picks one up; hold J to put it down.

battery2.name: Battery 2
battery2.text: Two charges: dash twice before it recharges.

legs2.name: Legs 2
legs2.text: Longer in the air: a running jump clears a wider rail.

kerb.text: Tall cover right at the kerb: hide, then step into its path.

setback.text: Tall cover set back from the road: too far to walk out in time.

deck.text: No cover by the road; Prototype 9's deck over it, its parapet gap above the lane.

rail.text: A K-rail along the kerb (a dash stops at it; a jump clears it), tall cover set back behind it.

low.text: Low cover only: planters and hedges. Standing, it sees you over them.

watched.text: Street cameras watch the tall cover; low cover lies out of their reach.

cones.text: No cover by the road; cones to carry.

walkin.text: walk into its path and let it hit you

kerbstep.text: hide at the kerb; step into its path at the last moment

dashcover.text: dash from tall cover into its path

drop.text: drop through the deck's parapet gap into its path

jumprail.text: run and jump the K-rail into its path

duckdash.text: duck behind low cover; dash into its path

blindspot.text: dash from the cover no camera sees

conebait.text: put a cone in its lane; stand where it swerves round it
